sloka: लक्ष्मणो ऽर्थं ततः श्रुत्वा शिरसा वन्द्य मैथिलीम् ।शिवमित्यब्रवीद्धृष्टो हृदयेन विशुष्यता ।। ७.४६.१८ ॥
transliteration: lakṣmaṇo 'rthaṁ tataḥ śrutvā śirasā vandya maithilīm ।śivamityabravīddhṛṣṭo hṛdayena viśuṣyatā ।। 7.46.18 ॥

translations.english: Lakshmana, having heard Sita's request, bowed his head to Maithili and, though outwardly appearing pleased, said "auspicious" with a heart that was inwardly grieving.
